card.name: Surnames of famous people
card.fires_on: The last name of a well-known person, right after a first name or initials, such as Bill Gates, John D. Rockefeller or Morgan Freeman. Also fires on the closing piece of a split surname.

modes.label: Full surname after first name
modes.description: A famous surname completes a first name or initials, often of a business figure, judge or celebrity.

modes.label: End of a split surname
modes.description: The final piece of a surname that the tokenizer splits into parts.
modes.example: Buzz Ald<<rin>>'s vision for journey to Mars

card.writes: It adds little clear meaning; the promoted tokens look like endings of foreign names and Chinese words for doctor or daughter.
card.plain: It lights up on the last name of a famous person, once the first name has been given.
